==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''July 1st - August 6th, 2022''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 8th place will play the playoffs
***1st and 2nd place are seeded into Semifinals
***3rd to 6th place are seeded into Quarterfinals
***7th and 8th place are seeded into Losers' Round 1
* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 18th - September 4th, 2022''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner and the runner-up qualify for [[World Championship/2022|World Championship 2022]]
